---
title: Julia capture facts
engine: julia
---

A cell with several expressions, `prompt`, and a numeric `echo`.

```{julia}
#| prompt: true
x = 1
println("first")
y = x + 1
```

```{julia}
#| echo: [2]
a = 1
b = 2
b
```

`warning: false` keeps the message and the raw stderr write and drops the warning.

```{julia}
#| warning: false
@info "keepme"
@warn "dropme"
println(stderr, "rawstderr")
1
```
